name: Create an email campaign draft
description: Create a regular email campaign in Draft state with only a name. First step of building a campaign; then set subject, recipients and content. A campaign is ready to schedule when all four parts (sender, recipients, subject, design) are complete. On the free plan A/B tests, tags and folders are paid features.

id.description: Campaign id used by every later step.

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Executed through the UI with request capture. Created two drafts. The web UI creates the campaign here before any other field is filled.

side_effects: Creates a draft. The sender defaults to the account owner. Nothing is sent.
